title: Binance Will List API3 (API3)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  API3 (API3)  and will open trading for  API3/BTC ,  API3/BUSD  and  API3/USDT  trading pairs at 2022-01-21 10:30 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  API3  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for API3 will open at 2022-01-22 10:30 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is API3 (API3)? API3 is a data oracle that enables APIs to feed data to blockchain applications directly without third-party middlemen. API3 is its native governance token that can be staked to receive rewards and act as collateral to provide a security guarantee on the data feed. API3 Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
